lines.1: 「You're a guest in this house, and you want the top spot?」
lines.2: 「Of course. I am older than you.」
lines.3: 「As I have said many times, a big sister naturally stands above her little brother.」
lines.4: 「Come. I will use one hand, but you may use both.」
lines.5: 「Otome, you underestimate me way too much.」
lines.6: 「Enough. Come at me. I will defeat you in an instant.」
lines.8: What could she possibly do with such a delicate hand?
lines.12: Even using both hands, I lost in an instant.
lines.13: 「This is reality. I stand above; you stand below.」
lines.19: 「Hah! I admire that spirit. Come as many times as you like!」
lines.21: 「Ngh... No... I can't believe I lost to a woman.」
lines.22: The back of my hand hurt from being slammed down so many times.
lines.23: 「If losing shocks you enough to bring tears to your eyes, you should stop.」
lines.24: 「You have never beaten me at arm wrestling, then or now.」
lines.26: 「How rude! My name is Otome--maiden! Does that not tell you clearly enough?」
lines.27: 「We train differently. While you indulged in idle sleep every day, I continued honing my body.」
lines.28: 「Being male or female has nothing to do with it.」
lines.29: 「You are weak, so I will protect you. That is all.」
lines.31: 「I am older. What is wrong with that?」
lines.32: Damn it. Her hand was so pale and soft. Where did that tremendous power come from?
lines.34: Still, Otome really did have beautifully shaped hands.
lines.35: 「Hey. Stop rubbing my hand so much. There is no trick or hidden device.」
lines.37: 「If the loss frustrates you, then train.」
lines.38: 「And above all, eat rice balls. Perhaps that is the secret of strength.」
lines.41: 「Sigh. I got completely crushed at arm wrestling by a girl.」
lines.42: It would be one thing if Otome looked sturdy, like a professional wrestler.
lines.43: But she was a slender beauty, which made losing this badly so frustrating.
